**Methods:**

```java
static boolean canCast(Spell spell);

static String getSelectedSpellName();

```

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `canCast(Spell spell)` | Checks if you can cast the given spell. |
| `canCast(Spell spell, boolean useBank)` | Checks if you can cast the given spell Does account for any staffs equipped. |
| `castSpell(Spell spell)` | Casts a spell |
| `castSpell(Spell spell, String action)` | Casts a spell with the given action |
| `castSpellOn(Spell spell, Entity entity)` | Casts a spell on an entity |
| `castSpellOn(Spell spell, Item item)` | Casts a spell on an item in inventory |
| `deselect()` | Deselects the current spell if one is selected |
| `getAutocastSpell()` | Gets the active spell that is selected via autocast |
| `getSelectedSpellName()` | Gets the currently selected spell name |
| `getSpellbook()` | Returns the current spellbook |
| `interact(Spell spell, String action)` | Interacts with the spell with the given action |
| `isSpellFilteringEnabled()` | This is used to check if spell filtering is enabled. |
| `isSpellSelected()` | Checks if a spell is currently selected |
| `setSpellFilteringEnabled(boolean enabled)` | Either enables or disables the spell filtering options in the Magic tab |
